name: @digi4care/omo-slim-decision-layer
description: Git-native decision register for OpenCode: typed records (REQ/CONSTRAINT/ASSUMPTION/DEC), owner ratification and traceability, as a companion plugin for oh-my-opencode-slim

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external @opencode-ai/plugin --external zod && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.release: bun run build && mkdir -p release && npm pack --pack-destination release
scripts.release:patch: npm version patch && npm run release && npm publish
scripts.release:minor: npm version minor && npm run release && npm publish
scripts.release:major: npm version major && npm run release && npm publish
